base.description: The g4poc FP8 base = PA's r03 (BASELINE-FP8.md, jumanzii/g4poc-a ac6035c07f): text-only compressed-tensors FP8 checkpoint (G4POC_MODEL_DIR default), FP8 KV, Triton attention + Triton fused_moe (default config), chunked prefill 4096. Same flags as baseline/serve.sh r03; PA launched from e3e4acf268, whose python/ is identical to this commit.

nvfp4-smoke.description: Harness smoke only (2026-10-04, coordinator-approved while the FP8 base is not up): gemma4nv's NVFP4 base, run with G4POC_MODEL_DIR at the NVFP4 snapshot. Never a g4poc result.
